---
title: "Data representations and operators"
format: html
---

Packed BED is the individual-level operator. CSR sparse LD and reconstructed
block eigen are summary-statistics operators. Marker and trait order are
explicit and preserved throughout preparation, sampling, formatting, and
diagnostics.

Operator preparation happens once per fit and is shared immutably across
logical chains. Block-eigen runtime storage is described by its represented
blocks and filter settings; it is not assumed to be permanently low rank.

Fit metadata records genotype, effect, phenotype, and LD scales plus total,
used, and per-trait sample sizes.
